description.text: Introduction: In 1983, the authority of Master Degree of Mechanical Design and Theory was acquired, and in 2000 the Doctor's Degree was authorized. The main research areas include mechanical strength and design, design methodology, optimization, reliability and CAD, industrial design. Many valuable research achievements and publications had been completed. About forty research projects of state-level are being carried out now. The research team and groups have professional research and teaching experiences. Most of the teachers had studied in USA, European countries, Australia. Research fields: (1) Mechanism of Robot (2) Mechanical Strength & Design (3) Optimization, Reliability & CAD (4) Industrial Design Core classes: Chinese Language, Numerical Calculation, Matrix Theory, Theory of Mechanical Strength, Mechanism Dynamics, Specialist Literature Readings, Computer Aided Design, Mechanism of Robot, Fracture Mechanics, Mechanical Vibration, Finite Element Method, Reliability Design, Ergonomics, Methodology of Product Design, Professional Chinese Reading, Optimal Design of Machinery, Methodology of Design, Electrical Measurement of Non-electric Parameters, Engineering Computer Graphic Simulation, Theory and Application of Product Information Modeling

duration.text: The Mechanical Design and Theory at Harbin Engineering University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5069 USD/per year ￥ 36500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Foreign citizens, in good health. 2.A Bachelor Degree in related courses. 3.TOFEL 550 or more, or IELTS 6.0 or more, or provide other Engslish proficiency certificate (naive speakers needn’t submit the English proficiency certificate)
